# Camera

Card type `custom:houseview-camera-card`, or `type: camera` in the `cards` list of `custom:houseview-card`. Available since 1.0.

Shows a still picture from a `camera.*` entity. The widget loads the entity's `entity_picture` and asks for a fresh
snapshot every 30 seconds, so the picture never goes stale and the camera is not polled harder than that. Only
pictures from your own Home Assistant (the page origin, or the `hassUrl` origin) and under `/camera_proxy/` are
loaded; anything else leaves the widget showing "Snapshot unavailable".

A long press opens the more-info dialog. When the card config has a `camera_gallery`, a tap opens the camera grid instead,
and the widget stays usable while its own camera is offline.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| entity | entity | required | A `camera.*` entity |
| name | string | friendly name | Label |
| size | normal/wide/tall/large | normal | Widget size on carousel pages |

## Camera grid (`camera_gallery`)

A card-level option (next to `cards`, not inside a widget) that adds a full-screen grid of up to four cameras. It also
works on a standalone camera card.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| entity | entity | required | A `camera.*` entity. One to four entries |
| name | string | friendly name | Label shown on the camera |
| slot | 0-3 | list position | Grid cell: 0 top left, 1 top right, 2 bottom left, 3 bottom right |
| stream | boolean | false | Use Home Assistant's MJPEG stream (`/camera_proxy_stream/`) instead of a snapshot every 5 s |

Tap a camera to enlarge it; Back (or the Escape key) steps back, first to the grid, then closes it. Pictures refresh
every 5 seconds while the grid is open, a camera that does not answer for 20 seconds reads "Camera not responding",
and a stream that failed is retried after 30 seconds. The grid is an `aria-modal` dialog and page swiping is
disabled while it is open. An invalid list fails with `Camera view needs one to four camera entities.`

```yaml
type: custom:houseview-camera-card
entity: camera.front_door
camera_gallery:
  - entity: camera.front_door
    name: Front door
  - entity: camera.garden
    stream: true
```
